name: MEDS 5351
title: Fundamentals of Biophysics
description: Fundamental biophysical, structural biology, and analytical approaches. Predicting protein structures and biophysical properties of macromolecules using AI and machine learning. Students will gain in-depth knowledge of the approaches highlighted in each module via lab demos and hands-on experiments. Additionally, students will immerse themselves in one/some of the techniques that they learn in their end-of-term projects.
